## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Gaṇikacetāpana Sikkhāpada* (Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 8) is a disciplinary rule from the Vinaya Piṭaka governing the conduct of Buddhist nuns (*bhikkhunīs*). The rule establishes that a nun who exchanges away a collective requisite that has been designated for a specific purpose commits an offense of expiation involving forfeiture, requiring her to relinquish the item and confess the transgression. The text has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali under the title *Exchanging designated collective property*.
